summary: Iteration 2 retest of The Alchemical Lexicon covering four new features: monster-art (Gemini image generation), Spoken Etymology narrate button, Crisis Vignettes (t-vents outcome images), and Root Archaeology tab. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass including new tests for /api/monster-art (400 on <2 reagents, 200 with data:image/... base64 URL + word object for chron+bio+phobia => 'Chronbiophobia', ~10s Gemini call), /api/lexicon root_journeys shape (oikos with 3 frames), and /api/trials t-vents outcome_image on all three options. Frontend: Enter Lab -> auto+crat success vignette with narrate-button toggle (no crash); words-charted counter increments to 1/18. Monster combo chron+morph in Form & Change constellation produces 'Chronmorph' rogue panel with illustrate-monster-button; clicking generates a real data:image/jpeg base64 image via /api/monster-art and swaps into vignette-image (took ~15s). Trials tab: t-vents wrong option (o1 Plutocrat) renders trial-outcome-image with plutocrat_fail image + feedback + Try again; correct option (o3 Technocrat) renders technocrat_win outcome image and marks trial mastered. Root Archaeology tab renders oikos journey with all three dots, next-button advances oikos -> economy -> ecology (each root-frame-image-* selector renders), dot click jumps back to oikos, root-speak-button clicks without exception.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger used inside monster_art exception handler is defined AFTER app setup (line 205) but at module top-level so it's still bound by call time — works, but style-wise logger should be initialized before use to avoid confusion.
SparkVignette: illustrate() has no user-facing error state — if /api/monster-art 500s (Gemini failure), spinner just stops with no toast. Consider surfacing an error toast.
RootArchaeology.speak inline duplication of speak() from SparkVignette — minor DRY, could be extracted to a shared util.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed session_ids created in progress collection; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Crucible transmute button testid is 'transmute-action-button' (not 'transmute-button'). Monster combo chron+morph -> 'Chronmorph'. /api/monster-art real Gemini call takes 5-15s — use timeout>=60s. Narrate/speak buttons use browser SpeechSynthesis (silent in headless) — only verify render/no-crash.
